component.name: sysmon
component.summary: See what your computer is doing right now

description.p: sysmon shows the live state of a Linux computer in one window: processor and per-core load, memory and swap, graphics card, temperatures and fans, battery health, disks, network connections and every running process.

ul.li: Graphs of the last two minutes for CPU, memory, temperature, disk and network
Graphics monitoring for AMD, NVIDIA and Intel
Battery charge, power draw, time left, health and charge cycles
A searchable process list with details (view only)
A hardware report you can copy into a help forum
Optional desktop alerts for a hot CPU, low battery, or full memory or disk
Export recent readings to a CSV file
Watch cloud and home servers over SSH, or use the terminal mode on a server

description.p: It reads everything locally from the kernel, needs no root access and sends nothing over the network.
Watch cloud and home servers over SSH in the same window, install sysmon on a server with one button, and a new terminal mode (sysmon --tui).
Clear advice instead of a crash on systems without fonts, and a font dependency in the packages.
Settings tab, desktop alerts, CSV export, a remembered window size, software drawing on machines without a usable GPU driver, and correct package dependencies.
